_meta.comment: Per-VRAM-tier default model selections for the installer's typed catalog UI. `tiers` maps a hardware tier (cpu, or the GPU VRAM budget in GB) to per-section default entry ids from catalog.json. The wizard resolves the tier from the detected GPU (nexus_installer/tier_defaults.py), fit-gates every id against detected VRAM and free disk, and pre-ticks the result; everything else in the catalog appears un-ticked for opt-in. v1.9.0 Phase 4: the agentic default is a Gemma 4 variant (Gemma 4 is agentic-coding-capable), so the agentic list is [<best-fitting Gemma 4 variant>, <coder fallback>] -- the Gemma is preferred and, because it is usually the same id as the chat pick, one model covers both chat and agentic; the coding specialist is the in-list fallback taken only when no Gemma 4 variant fits. v1.19.0 Phase 1: cpu agentic prefers LFM2.5-2.6B ahead of Gemma / the small coder; the 8 GB list inserts LFM between Gemma and the 9B Qwen 3.5 so sub-6 GB cards that cannot hold gemma4:e4b still get a dedicated agentic default; 12 uses Qwen 3.5 9B, 16 uses gpt-oss 20B, 24 uses Qwen3-Coder 30B. chat/agentic are single-pick sections; embed/image/audio/video take every fitting id. image/video defaults are the uncensored entries (the v1.8.0 product decision) on tiers whose hardware fits them; the cpu tier gets no image/video (diffusion requires a GPU). Audio defaults are the permissive, CPU-capable speech models (faster-whisper STT + Kokoro TTS) on every tier. Extra 2025 embedders stay opt-in; nomic-embed-text remains the required memory default. v2.2.3 Phase 7: the document section defaults RapidOCR PP-OCRv4 (CPU-capable, portable) on the cpu and 8 tiers and Unlimited-OCR 3B (12 GB VRAM, NVIDIA-only quality tier) on 12/16/24, so the Document tab is never empty.
